rationale: v12n showed all six selected endpoints lose net local slope across phases while crossing penalty falls. Test a new fit-only temporal weighting mechanism against exact ERM with fixed architecture/input/output support; do not infer a proven shift cause or new information.

fit_groups.assignment: Positive report t0 into four consecutive 28-day blocks within the original fit period. No outcome-derived bins; these are overlapping-dependent training environments, not independent validation folds.

weighting.initial: pi_g = original fit valid candidate H1-H6 cell mass in group g / full fit mass; q_0=pi. Require positive support in all four groups.
weighting.loss: For each original minibatch, multiply each valid early cell absolute standardized error by q_g/pi_g, divide by ORIGINAL valid early minibatch count, add unchanged 0.001 candidate-vector energy penalty. Do not self-normalize weighted minibatch counts or change sample order. q is fixed throughout each epoch. ERM always uses original early_train_epoch.
weighting.update: After complete epoch inference on fit incident_full only: u_g=(MAE_g(P_epoch)-MAE_g(A))/MAE_fit(A), with one common fixed baseline scale. v=softmax(log(q)+20*u); q_next=0.05*pi+0.95*v. Positive excess harm increases weight relative to less harmed groups. No selection/audit labels affect weights.
weighting.interpretation: Multiplicative temporal excess-loss reweighting with coverage mixture, not a certified population DRO bound. It changes learned weights, not final-output lambda. Zero benefit is a legitimate result; no rate/mixture search.

training.objective: Original standardized candidate H1-H6 MAE with fit-only frozen-per-epoch group weights; unchanged vector energy regularizer.

selection: Original v12k candidate_early selection and all sixteen v12c guards on projected candidate-early P only; epoch 0 is A, strict better/earlier ties. Same rule for both objectives. No worst-block or audit-based checkpoint selection.
paired_design: For each seed/architecture, same fresh zero-residual initialization, Adam settings, sample permutation, batches, epoch budget, full-fit evaluation and selection visits. Epoch-1 adapter state must match exactly before temporal weights first change. Both architectures remain prespecified. All twelve identities freeze before audit Y evaluation.
primary: audit incident_full candidate_h1_h6 pooled gain: temporal_excess minus ERM (MAE_ERM-MAE_temporal). Co-report both objectives versus A for every architecture and seed. A relative gain while both remain worse than A does not establish useful correction.
evaluation: Retain all original phases/cohorts and four regions. Projected late/noncandidate outputs equal native A exactly. Save window errors/support and fixed-endpoint G/S/O. Report shared week and four-week paired intervals, pooled and equal-window weights. Recompute paired differences within each draw; never subtract marginal CI bounds. No best-seed claim.

bootstrap.calendar: Original continuous phase ISO-week grid including empty weeks; reconcile saved matrices and deterministic generator.
bootstrap.shared_draws: All models, cohorts, G/S/O and matched contrasts use the same phase weights. Compute ratios and contrast within each draw; never subtract CI endpoints.
bootstrap.interpretation: Pointwise intervals conditional on saved weights, reused development and nine audit weeks. No joint 95 percent mechanism claim, seed independence or new success gate.

recovery: Atomic epoch boundary with current adapter, Adam moments/settings/step count, q for next epoch, fit-group history, selected historical best, RNG, run/input/code/device identity. Replay q and selection independently on restore. New destination only; source read-only; recompute final evaluations after all selected identities freeze. Completed trajectories do not optimize again.

independent_confirmation_plan.candidate: A distinct 2024 cohort; continuous traffic windows are not yet fully materialized. First certify and freeze source version, event identities, report-time availability, sensor coverage and temporal supports without consulting prediction outcomes.
independent_confirmation_plan.past_only_requirement: Every A/scaler/adapter fit, checkpoint choice and method choice must use only observations prior to confirmation windows. Audit the existing 2023 artifacts and exposure ledger; rebuild from a certified past-only package if provenance cannot establish this. Do not relabel the repeatedly used 2023 audit/val or previously exposed test as fresh confirmation.
independent_confirmation_plan.evaluation: Freeze the entire selected system and cohort before confirmation targets are evaluated; carry paired baseline, all prescribed seeds and ordinary-traffic safeguards. No confirmation-driven retuning.
